newsitem.title: USA: Houston Ship Channel shut by fog - pilots.
newsitem.headline: Houston Ship Channel shut by fog - pilots.

text.p: The Houston Ship Channel remained shut Thursday morning by a heavy fog that has blanketed parts of the southeast Texas coastline since late Wednesday, a spokeswoman for the ship channel pilots said.
The closure has delayed 25 inbound and 12 outbound deep- draft ships, the spokeswoman said. The channel was shut at 1709 CST on Wednesday and will reopen once the fog lifts, she said.
"This is an unusually heavy fog. It's really thick out there," she said.
The channel is a critical commercial waterway connecting Houston's port and refinery row to Galveston Bay and the Gulf of Mexico.
